data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to display your app over other apps on the screen.
data.what_it_does: Allows rendering a Flutter app as an overlay window above other applications on Android. It supports customized positioning, flags like click-through or focusable pointers, data sharing via streams between the main app and overlay, and drag-to-dismiss configurations.
use_when: You need to build chat heads or floating widgets similar to Messenger or TrueCaller.
You want to display persistent overlay information over other apps on Android.
avoid_when: Your target platform includes iOS or web (it is Android-only).
You only need standard in-app notifications or banners.
strengths: Provides APIs to resize, move, show, hide, and update the overlay window dynamically.
Supports drag-to-dismiss functionality with custom appearance targets.
Allows sharing data between the main app and the overlay via streams.
weaknesses: Requires manual addition of native permissions and service configuration in Android Manifest.
data.setup_notes: Add SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW, FOREGROUND_SERVICE, and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE permissions to AndroidManifest.xml and declare the OverlayService.
data.minimal_example:
final bool status = await FlutterOverlayWindow.requestPermission();
await FlutterOverlayWindow.showOverlay();
